about: The gallery mods (site/mods/) and how each is checked. See evals/gallery-check.js. `from` borrows the checker of an eval case in evals/cases.json. `existing` mods were written before this list and are only verified.

cases.title: Dark mode
cases.request: dark mode for the whole page, including the sidebar on the right, with text that's easy to read
check: return T.darkPage('.project-description p, .project-description li, .project-description h1, .project-description h2, .project-header__name, .project-header__summary, .sidebar-section h3, .sidebar-section a, .vertical-tabs__tab, .site-header a')
cases.how: Most of the screen is dark, and at least 92% of the description, header, tabs and sidebar text has a contrast of 4.5 or more.

cases.title: Install command always in view
cases.label: “pip install requests” command
cases.request: keep the pip install command visible at the top while I scroll
check: if (!T.inView(e)) return 'the install command is not in view after scrolling: top ' + Math.round(T.rect(e).top);
if (T.rect(e).bottom > innerHeight * 0.4) return 'what stays at the top covers too much of the page: ' + Math.round(T.rect(e).bottom) + 'px';
const pinned = T.$$('.banner *, header *').filter(x => T.inView(x) && x.textContent.trim() && !x.children.length && T.rect(x).top < innerHeight * 0.4);
if (faint.length) return 'text pinned at the top is hard to read: “' + faint[0].textContent.trim().slice(0, 30) + '” ' + T.contrast(faint[0]).toFixed(1);
const below = T.$$('.project-description *').filter(x => { const r = T.rect(x); return T.visible(x) && x.textContent.trim() && r.top > T.rect(e).bottom + 4 && r.bottom < innerHeight; });
return below.length > 0 || 'no project description in view under it';
cases.how: Scrolls 2,500px down: the pip install command is still fully in view and not covered, what stays at the top takes less than 40% of the screen and its text is readable (contrast 3 or more), and description text shows under it.

cases.title: Hide pre-releases and yanked versions
cases.request: in the release history, hide the releases marked pre-release or yanked
check: if (!odd.length) return 'no pre-releases on the page to hide';
if (odd.some(T.visible)) return odd.filter(T.visible).length + ' pre-release or yanked versions still show';
return ok.length > 50 || 'only ' + ok.length + ' normal releases still show';
cases.how: Opens Release history: no pre-release or yanked version shows, and more than 50 normal releases still do.

check: return !small.length || small.length + ' code examples still under 16px: ' + T.fontPx(small[0].querySelector('code') || small[0]);
cases.how: The first six code examples are at least 16px.

cases.title: Contents on the side
cases.label: “Table of contents”
cases.request: show the table of contents on the right side and keep it there while I scroll
check: if (links.length < 3) return 'the contents are not in view on the right after scrolling (' + links.length + ' links)';
const ps = T.$$('#apicontent p').filter(p => { const r = T.rect(p); return T.visible(p) && r.top > 0 && r.bottom < innerHeight; });
return ps.every(p => T.rect(p).right <= T.rect(links[0]).left + 2) || 'the contents cover the text';
cases.how: Scrolls to 60% of the page: at least three contents links are in view on the right half, and no paragraph in view runs under them.

cases.title: J and K to jump between sections
cases.request: let me press j and k to jump to the next and previous section
check: const y1 = scrollY; if (y1 <= y0 + 40) return 'j did not move down';
if (!heads().some(h => Math.abs(T.rect(h).top) < 140)) return 'j did not stop at a section heading';
const y2 = scrollY; if (y2 <= y1 + 10) return 'a second j did not move further down';
return scrollY < y2 - 10 || 'k did not move back up';
cases.how: Presses j (real key): the page moves down to a section heading; j again moves further; k moves back up.

cases.title: Focus timer
cases.label: Share, star and more buttons
cases.request: add a 25 minute focus timer here that I can start and pause
check: const time = () => { const m = txt().match(/(\d{1,2})\s*:\s*(\d{2})/); return m ? +m[1] * 60 + +m[2] : null; };
if (time() !== 1500) return 'does not show 25:00 before starting: ' + txt().slice(0, 80);
const t1 = time(); if (t1 == null || t1 >= 1500 || t1 < 1490) return 'not counting down after start: ' + txt().slice(0, 80);
await T.click(pause); await T.sleep(300); const t2 = time(); await T.sleep(1600);
return time() === t2 || 'still counting after pause: ' + t2 + ' then ' + time();
cases.how: Shows 25:00; clicking start (real click) counts down; clicking pause stops it.
